doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: 24 years at Luchenbach's and going to Bunkie in the war
summary: Billie says she stayed at Luchenbach's about 24 years and went to Bunkie during the war.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Well, how long did you stay at Lutchen's?
I stayed at Lutchen's, you know, about 24 years.
But when you were there with Big Eye and Rogers, you turned it over to Rogers, huh? Yeah.
They were there, you know, running... Huh? I don't know. I went to Bunky. I went to Bunky.
Oh, that was during the war. You went to Bunky during the war? Yeah. Yeah, I was in the Bunky.
I seen one of my club play time post the card the other day. Let me see if I can find that card. I had a other job cleaning up my shipping room.
